fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on the Georgia Phillips/Huttoe civil-rights suit implications for Miami arrests; support for City Commissioner H. Leslie Quigg regarding the Graves Tract and criticism of a proposed Miami world’s fair; advocacy against a Florida sales tax with reader letters and coupons; a public-health appeal urging school admission precautions to reduce polio risk from returning vacationers; criticism of “raw young cops” and discourteous traffic enforcement; complaints about low-flying training planes over residential areas; reports on zoning board activity, municipal water billing practices, Miami Beach public beach acquisition proposals, and assorted state/national items including Judge George E. Holt’s talks on Israel, citrus canners opposing a new code, and oil drilling promotion in South Florida.
